desc: admitted: not a template query (notDerived)
old:
let some listed := listedOf partition
    | throw (Flock.OneCircuit.notDerived
        "lower : C_S of a partition that is no template query (Q_template_instance, Q_template_instances) -> its Boolean block circuit")

desc: one-template: C_S's root not a Definition
old: let some root := S.defs[S.root]? | notAdmitted "one-template" "C_S's root is not one of its Definitions"

desc: one-template: the root calls more than one template
old:
let #[key] := keys
    | notAdmitted "one-template" s!"C_S's root calls {keys.toList}, and a block's units are instances of one template"

desc: listed: template not listed by the query
old: if !listed.contains key then notAdmitted "listed"

desc: listed: template not in C_S's index
old: let some d := S.index[key]? | notAdmitted "listed" s!"C_S's template {key} is no Definition of C_S"

desc: listed: index names no Definition
old: let some fn := S.defs[d]? | notAdmitted "listed" s!"C_S's template {key} is no Definition of C_S"

desc: port-names: a parameter name not plain
old: if let some (n, _) := fn.params.find? (!plainName ·.1) then

desc: port-names: a port named twice
old: if let some n := names.find? fun n => (names.filter (· == n)).size > 1 then
new: if let some n := names.find? fun n => (names.filter (· == n)).size > 1 && false then

desc: on-bits: the lift to bits refuses
old: | .error _ => notAdmitted "on-bits" s!"the lift to bits refuses C_S's template {key}"

desc: on-bits: reaches a wide composite (wideFrom)
old: if let some w := (wideFrom L dl)[0]? then
new: if let some w := ((wideFrom L dl)[0]?).filter (fun _ => false) then

desc: cut-rows: a cut names no parameter
old:
let some (_, t) := fn.params.find? (·.1 == p)
      | notAdmitted "cut-rows" s!"C_S's template {key}: a cut names {p}, which is no parameter"
new:
let some (_, t) := fn.params.find? (·.1 == p)
      | continue

desc: cut-rows: a cut not into equal runs of one width
old: if k < 2 || (Flock.Program.Widths.homo t).isNone || t.leaves % k != 0 then

desc: whole-words: no return field
old: if fields.isEmpty then notAdmitted "whole-words"

desc: whole-words: a row or field not whole u16 words
old: if let some (n, b) := rs.find? fun (_, b) => b == 0 || b % 16 != 0 then
new: if let some (n, b) := rs.find? fun (_, b) => (b == 0 || b % 16 != 0) && false then

desc: leaves-are-bits: no lifted Definition
old: let some l := L.defs[dl]? | notAdmitted "leaves-are-bits" s!"C_S's template {key} has no lift to bits"

desc: leaves-are-bits: leaves differ from bits (leavesOff)
old: if let some why := leavesOff fn l then
new: if let some why := (leavesOff fn l).filter (fun _ => false) then

desc: no-recut: C's root not a Definition
old: let some root := P.defs[P.root]? | notAdmitted "no-recut" "C's root is not one of its Definitions"

desc: no-recut: C's root reads an input node recut
old: if !root.body.recut.isEmpty then

desc: disjoint-ranges: a unit named twice
old: if named[i - 1]! == named[i]! then notAdmitted

desc: one-callee: unit's scope Definition missing (unitAt/child)
old: let some d := P.defs[sc.d]? | notAdmitted "one-callee" s!"unit {u}'s callee is no Definition of C"

desc: disjoint-ranges: two units share gates
old: if lo < hi then notAdmitted "disjoint-ranges"

desc: one-callee: unit is no node of C's root
old: let some x := root.body.nodes[k]? | notAdmitted "one-callee" s!"unit {u} is no node of C's root"

desc: one-callee: node's callee is no Definition
old: let some f := P.defs[x.fn]? | notAdmitted "one-callee" s!"unit {u}'s callee is no Definition of C"

desc: one-callee: unit calls another template
old: if f.key != key then notAdmitted "one-callee"

desc: operands-outside: a unit reads a gate of the block
old: if let some (v, _, _, _, _) := us.find? fun (_, _, _, lo, hi) => lo ≤ g && g < hi then
new: if let some (v, _, _, _, _) := us.find? fun (_, _, _, lo, hi) => lo ≤ g && g < hi && false then

desc: lowerBlock: admittedBlock (formed) not called
old:
let a ← admitted partition cuts S
  formed a.key
new: let a ← admitted partition cuts S
